data.narrative:
CruxOCM is a Series A climate and energy technology company that has raised $26.1M to date. The valuation universe for comparison comprises one public company and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including notable names such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis applies here, using the $26.1M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement. This method yields an implied valuation of $52M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient granular comparables—while eight same-sector peers exist, none met narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier benchmarking. A broad sector median would risk being misleading given the heterogeneity of climate tech business models and commercialization timelines.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $44M to $60M, with a median point of $52M. This range reflects the stage-progression methodology and incorporates reasonable sensitivity around the 2.0x multiplier. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight-peer benchmarking data, the nascent and varied nature of climate-tech valuations, and whether the capital-raised proxy accurately reflects current investor consensus on value. Additional data on customer traction, IP position, and burn rate would refine the range further.
